name: Neill-Cochran House Museum
hours_summary: Wed–Sat · 11 AM – 4 PM · Sun 1 PM – 5 PM · closed Mon–Tue
tagline: An 1855 Greek Revival mansion near UT — and Austin's only surviving slave quarters on-site.
description: An 1855 Greek Revival mansion near the UT campus, operated by the National Society of the Colonial Dames. Alongside the main house, a restored outbuilding is the only surviving slave quarters in Austin still standing where it was built, with a permanent exhibition on the lives of the people enslaved there.

tips.text: The slave quarters exhibition is small but the point of a modern visit — don't skip the outbuilding.
Docent-led tours leave on the hour — arrive a few minutes early.

highlights.item: Austin's only in-place antebellum slave quarters, with a permanent exhibition
1850s period rooms and original limestone construction

distance_landmark: Just west of UT campus, 1.2 mi from the Capitol
